config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / greatest(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 1), 2) AS rps FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests'

SELECT round(100 * sumIf(delta, Attributes['status_code'] >= '500' AND Attributes['status_code'] <= '599') / greatest(sum(delta), 1), 2) AS rate FROM (SELECT Attributes, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY Attributes)

SELECT round(100 * sumIf(delta, Attributes['status_code'] = '429') / greatest(sum(delta), 1), 2) AS rate FROM (SELECT Attributes, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY Attributes)
SELECT round(1000 * sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 1) AS mean_ms FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_request_duration_seconds'

tiles.name: Requests per second by status code

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['status_code'] AS status_code, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS rps FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, status_code ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['method'] AS method, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS rps FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, method ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['method'] AS method, round(1000 * sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 1) AS mean_ms FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_request_duration_seconds' GROUP BY ts, method ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['status_code'] AS status_code, max(Value) - min(Value) AS requests FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, status_code ORDER BY ts

SELECT SpanAttributes['http.route'] AS probe, StatusCode AS status, count() AS checks, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6), 1) AS p95_ms, max(Timestamp) AS last_seen FROM $__sourceTable WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__filters AND (SpanAttributes['http.route'] = '/api/health' OR SpanAttributes['http.route'] = '/api/live') GROUP BY probe, status ORDER BY checks DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['status_code'] AS status_code, round(1000 * sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 1) AS mean_ms FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_request_duration_seconds' GROUP BY ts, status_code ORDER BY ts

SELECT signal, verdict, round(age, 0) AS age_seconds, toDateTime(now()) AS checked_at FROM (SELECT 'http_request_duration_seconds' AS signal, dateDiff('second', max(TimeUnix), now()) AS age, multiIf(age <= 120, 'fresh', age <= 600, 'stale', 'silent') AS verdict FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND MetricName = 'http_request_duration_seconds' UNION ALL SELECT 'http_requests' AS signal, dateDiff('second', max(TimeUnix), now()) AS age, multiIf(age <= 120, 'fresh', age <= 600, 'stale', 'silent') AS verdict FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND MetricName = 'http_requests' UNION ALL SELECT 'otel_traces' AS signal, dateDiff('second', max(Timestamp), now()) AS age, multiIf(age <= 120, 'fresh', age <= 600, 'stale', 'silent') AS verdict FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp > toDateTime64(0, 9, 'UTC') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR UNION ALL SELECT 'otel_logs' AS signal, dateDiff('second', max(Timestamp), now()) AS age, multiIf(age <= 120, 'fresh', age <= 600, 'stale', 'silent') AS verdict FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > toDateTime64(0, 9, 'UTC') AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) ORDER BY age_seconds ASC
